name: Piercing Trap (Metaconstruction)
body:
Your studies have helped you develop methods to overcome spell resistance.

Benefit: When you create a piercing trap and its effects trigger on a target with spell resistance, it treats the spell resistance of the target as 5 lower than its actual SR. A piercing trap uses up a trap slot one level higher than the trap’s actual level.
